About
We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence.
There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting.
Focus:
Designing how AI capabilities are introduced into everyday phone usage.

Responsibilities
Design AI-native interaction patterns.
Explore voice, touch and conversational interfaces.
Design contextual and proactive AI experiences.
Design workflows across different applications.
Reduce the need for explicit prompting.
Make agent actions transparent and easy to control.
Prototype and validate new interaction models.
Work closely with product and engineering teams.

Requirements
Strong product / interaction design experience.
Experience designing mobile applications or complex user workflows.
Strong prototyping skills.
Understanding of usability and user behavior.
Strong product thinking and visual communication.

Nice to have
AI assistant or conversational UX experience.
Operating system or mobile platform experience.
Voice and multimodal interaction design.
Experience designing proactive experiences.
